posts.post:
we finally settled on a 300gsm cotton for the new collection.

if you hate a heavy drape, you’re just wrong.

some guys look put together in a sack, while others try too hard in expensive labels.

it’s never about the brand name.

everyone has that one heavy hoodie they refuse to throw away, even with the frayed cuffs.

what’s keeping it in the rotation?

ironing a t-shirt is a chore.

either the fabric holds its own or it isn't worth the closet space.
